initial_decision.brief_rationale: R211-1 establishes randomized assignment, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference, identifying the causal risk difference. The exact population risks are 8/80 = 0.10 under X=1 and 24/120 = 0.20 under X=0; their difference is -0.10.
